pages.title: Research
pages.text: Research My research focuses on scalable machine learning, distributed optimization, and communication-efficient training for large-scale learning systems. Communication-Efficient Distributed Optimization I study distributed learning algorithms that reduce communication cost while preserving or improving convergence behavior. One line of work uses quantization to reduce per-iteration communication by more than 50 percent, while also helping optimization escape saddle points more efficiently. Distributed Learning Quantization Optimization Gradient Clipping and Saddle Avoidance I develop clipping-based optimization methods that improve stability and accelerate saddle-point escape. These methods show stronger time-to-accuracy performance on large-scale neural network training tasks. Gradient Clipping Training Stability Large-Scale ML Decentralized Optimization I work on decentralized optimization over directed graphs, with attention to heterogeneous objectives and generalized smoothness. My goal is to build methods that are both theoretically grounded and practically efficient. Decentralized Learning Directed Graphs Heterogeneity Scientific Computing and Benchmarking I am also interested in reproducible benchmarking and scientific computing, especially for comparing learning algorithms under realistic computational and communication constraints.
